DIPANJAN MALLICK 

Data Engineering Manager

+91- 888-484-0489 | mallickdipanjan@gmail.com | Bengaluru, KA, IN | LinkedIn StackOverflow 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Customer-obsessed, results-oriented Data Engineering Manager with 11+ years of experience leading global engineering teams and architecting scalable, cost-optimized, cloud-native data platforms across AWS (S3, EMR, Redshift, Athena), Azure, and Databricks – with strong sense of ownership and high business impact.

Specialized in architecting S3-based Data Lakes, OLAP analytics layers, ETL/ELT pipelines, Open Table Formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake), distributed systems, Big Data processing (Spark, EMR, Hadoop, Hive), centralized metrics repositories, automated data classification, lineage tracking, and data governance frameworks across Finance, Risk & Compliance, Retail, and Marketing domains.

Strong advocate of automated compliance validation frameworks, data quality frameworks with staging-first policies, metadata management, secure data handling aligned with regulatory standards, and cross-functional self-service capabilities that empower business teams to operate independently.

Proven track record of working backwards from business problems to architect automation-first, intelligence-led data solutions; drives roadmap prioritization, mentor engineers, evaluates emerging technologies, and delivers measurable business impact in global, cross-functional environments.

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

Data Engineering ETL/ELT, Data Pipelines, Data Modeling, SCD, S3 Data Lake Architecture, OLAP Analytics Layer, Centralized Metrics Repository, Airflow/MWAA, dbt, Automated Validation Pipelines Cloud Platforms AWS: S3, EMR, Athena, Glue, Redshift, API Gateway, DynamoDB, MWAA Microsoft Azure: ADLS Gen2, Databricks, Unity Catalog, ADF, Azure DevOps, Logic Apps, Azure Functions Big Data Spark (PySpark), Delta Lake, Hadoop, Hive, Presto, Iceberg, EMR, Apache Kafka Databases PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server Programming Language Python and SQL Tools Git, JIRA, Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ IDEA, dbt (Data Build Tool), AWS Glue Data Catalog, CloudWatch, QuickSight, Power BI Governance & Compliance Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Automated Data Classification, Compliance Validation Frameworks, Regulatory Standards, Security & Auditability, Data Quality (Staging-First Policies)

WORK EXPERIENCE 

Straive 	Chennai (Remote) 

Data Engineering Manager	Apr 2025 – Present

Led a 7-member engineering pod architecting and delivering a scalable S3-based data lake unifying structured and unstructured data from 15 disparate sources, managing 500GB/day across 1500+ datasets for NFL Gridiron marketing and fan analytics; drove Agile sprints, roadmap prioritization, and quarterly business reviews.

Architected a cost-performance-optimized ELT framework using PySpark on EMR, MWAA, Redshift (OLAP layer), and dbt with mixed hourly, daily, and event-driven pipelines; established engineering best practices including design reviews, code standards, and reusability patterns. Improved pipeline performance by 45% using optimized partitioning, Parquet formats, and Redshift dist/sort keys.



Built scalable Data Quality Framework implementing staging-first policies with automated validation pipelines (null, threshold, and rule-based checks); improved data integrity by 63% and reduced manual QA efforts by 50%. Established automated data classification and lineage tracking to ensure regulatory compliance and discoverability.

Designed extensible metrics schemas and a centralized metrics repository serving as source of truth for all reports and dashboards; implemented schema evolution, dependency-aware DAG chaining, event-driven orchestration, and optimized partition strategies – significantly improving pipeline SLAs and enabling self-service analytics.

Delivered complex marketing/fan-analytics transformation (churn models, rolling window fan activity, nested JSON based outbound pipelines).

Enabled BI, Marketing and Fan Engagement teams to measure campaign performance, fan segmentation, merchandise conversion and funnel analytics.

Provided leadership across architecture design, technical design/code reviews, mentoring engineers at all levels, stakeholder alignment, and cross-pod collaboration; championed high sense of ownership over every deliverable, evaluated emerging technologies, and fostered a culture of technical excellence and self-service capability.

Amazon | Corp FP&A 	Bangalore 

Manager II	Sep 2022 – Mar 2025 

Owned architecture, delivery and reliability of Hydros – a 10TB/day S3-based financial data lake serving as the centralized metrics repository and source of truth for FCF reporting; drove OP1/OP2/WTR roadmap planning and directly influenced investor-facing metrics tied to Amazon’s stock performance.

Led a 4-engineer team across system design, execution, and on-call. Modernized legacy workflows into automation-first PySpark-on-EMR (massively parallel processing) based pipelines, eliminating manual processes and reducing total runtime by 68%. Drove cost-optimization through right-sizing EMR clusters and workload scheduling.

Designed and implemented a scalable Data Quality Framework integrated via MWAA, incorporating staging-first policies and automated validation pipelines; reduced DQ failures by 47% and enabled automated ticketing for failed validations – ensuring data handling met Amazon’s security and compliance standards.

Delivered major reliability enhancements through schema evolution (Iceberg) on S3/Athena, missing partition detection, AQE-based skew handling, and lineage-driven impact analysis; enforced data modeling standards and metadata management (lineage tracking, automated data classification) for governance compliance. Reduced MTTR to 6-7 hours for SEV1 and <24 hours for SEV2 incidents.

Handled 1 SEV1 and 3-4 SEV2 incidents weekly as part of a 12-hour on-call rotation across IST/PST, implementing root-cause mechanisms that reduced recurrence.

Led technical execution – task assignment, design/code reviews, architectural decisions, and cross-functional alignment with FP&A, Finance Tech, and central engineering teams; collaborated with global stakeholders to gather requirements and translate complex business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions.

Anheuser-Busch inBev 	Bangalore 

Data Engineer III 	May 2021- Sep 2022 

Built scalable ETL pipelines on Azure Databricks (massively parallel processing) with Delta Lake, reducing processing time by 60% and improving data reliability for 20M+ records daily across a global data lake integrating brewery systems from disparate sources; leveraged Unity Catalog for centralized data governance, access control, and cross-workspace data discovery.

Developed optimized data pipelines for extraction, transformation, and aggregation managing historical data changes (SCD); established metadata management with automated data classification using Erwin Data Catalog, improving lineage tracking, discoverability, and regulatory compliance.

Integrated Apache Kafka for real-time ingestion of brewery production and sensor data feeds into the Databricks pipeline, and set up Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment of data workflows, improving release consistency.

Deloitte USI | Strategy & Analytics 	Bangalore 

Consultant (Data Engineer) 	 Mar 2019 – Apr 2021 



Developed scalable ETL pipelines for MS Azure-based secure, compliant data lake with automated compliance validation frameworks and data quality checks, ensuring 99.99% data availability and adherence to regulatory standards; used Azure DevOps to manage source control, build pipelines, and automated deployment of ETL jobs.

Optimized data processing workflows, enforced data modeling standards and lineage tracking, improving performance and enabling efficient handling of large-scale datasets for business intelligence and analytics.

Built centralized metrics repository and BI dashboards (OLAP-based analytics layer) enabling sales tracking, competitive analytics, and revenue optimization; transformed reporting operations into an intelligence-led framework improving marketing-driven sales by 26%.

Accenture | Digital 	Pune 

Application Development Analyst (ETL Developer) 	 Jun 2015 – Feb 2019 

Automated data processing workflows, enhancing data accuracy and consistency while minimizing manual intervention.

Developed a scalable reporting framework to streamline insights generation, improving efficiency and decision-making.

PROJECTS 

Straive

	NFL Gridiron ELT & Validation Platform 										Tech Used: PySpark, EMR, MWAA, Redshift, dbt

Architected a multi-source ELT framework ingesting 500GB/day from 15 sources and transforming 1500+ datasets for NFL marketing and fan analytics.

Built automated DQ framework (null/threshold/business checks) to achieve 63% higher data integrity and 50% reduced manual QA.

Delivered churn models, rolling fan-activity windows, and nested JSON outbound pipelines enabling campaign ROI & fan segmentation analytics

Amazon 

Free Cash Flow (FCF) Platform Modernization

Tech Used: PySpark, EMR, Athena, Iceberg, DynamoDB, Lambda, MWAA

Re-architected Amazon’s FCF data flow (10TB/day) from manual Excel-heavy processes to automated EMR pipelines.

Reduced end-to-end runtime by 68%, eliminated manual reporting loops across AWS, Prime, Music, Internal teams (within Amazon) finance.

Delivered validation & reliability framework reducing data quality failures by 47% and cutting MTTR for SEV1 incidents to ~6 hours.

Anheuser-Busch inBev 

BrewDat Global Data Platform

Tech Used: Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark SQL, ADF, Apache Kafka, Azure DevOps, Erwin Data Catalog

Built data mesh integrating brewery systems across markets.

Reduced data retrieval time by 40%, improved metadata discoverability by 60%, and cut approval overhead by 50%.

Deloitte

 	Digital Marketing Analytics 

Tech Used: Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Server, PySpark, Azure DevOps and Power BI 

Designed data models & pipelines powering sales tracking and competitive analytics.

Improved campaign insights leading to a 26% increase in optimized marketing driven sales

Accenture Digital 

Developed an ETL framework for retail sales insights, helping customers analyze store performance across North America. Enabled data-driven decisions on inventory and logistics, leading to a 43% increase in quarterly sales.

EDUCATION  

KIIT University, Bhubaneswar 

[2015] - B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering CGPA: 7.94

Delhi Public School, Dhanbad 

[2011] - 12th CBSE Grade: 80.5%

[2009] - 10th CBSE Grade: 85.6%

• 	Extra-Mile Award – FY24

Received for doing all the ground work necessary to help deliver a key Amazon Corp FPA goal a month ahead of the expectation 

• 	Excellence Award – FY22

Received Recognition of Excellence on outstanding performance of owning the Erwin Implementation Challenges in Anheuser-Busch inBev 

• 	Outstanding Award – FY20

Received in Deloitte USI for incredible client handling, understanding the requirements and flawless deliverables for Digital Marketing project 

• 	Applause & Spot Award – FY19

Received in Deloitte USI for exceptional performance and contributions on a digital marketing project, and providing positive reinforcement for going above and beyond in the moment 

• 	ACE Award – FY18

Received in Accenture for impeccable dedication towards work and on time delivery of the sprints
